kinds.name_hu_help.text: Optional. Hungarian users see the English name when this is empty.

kinds.events.intro.text: The kinds an event can have, in the order they are listed. Archived kinds cannot be picked for new events. The required kind is used for generated trainings: it can be renamed but not archived or deleted.

kinds.resources.intro.text: The kinds a resource can have, in the order they are listed. Archived kinds cannot be picked for new resources.

kinds.error.invalid_name.text: Enter an English name of up to 48 characters, and a Hungarian name of up to 48 characters or none.

kinds.error.name_taken.text: Another active kind already has this name.

kinds.error.in_use.text: This kind is in use. Archive it instead.

kinds.error.protected.text: This kind is required and cannot be archived or deleted.

kinds.error.too_many.text: This group has the most kinds it can have.
